name: Gunslinger
fantasy: The duelist. A rhythm of six, trick shots off walls, slide and reload.

card.loop: Hits and rolls load six Chambers; at 6 your Trick Shot is a Called Shot: a stunning crit that reloads you.
card.dash: Tap to roll (+2 Chambers, a third of a reload); hold to slide and shoot, full reload at the end.
card.passive: Chambers: each weapon hit loads one, a roll two; at 6 the gun glows gold: Called Shot.
card.rmb: A ricochet Trick Shot off walls and foes; hold for a piercing Rail Charge.
card.e: Quickdraw: 3s of faster fire, an instant reload and a dash charge back.
card.r: Lock every rival in sight, then fire one round per lock.

weapons.rifle: Steady auto fire; damage drops on long strings.

passive.name: Six Chambers
passive.desc: Each weapon hit loads a chamber (one per 0.25s); a tap roll loads 2. At 6 the gun glows gold and your next Trick Shot is a Called Shot: +70% (a Rail +35%), a crit and stun 0.4, and when it lands the cylinder spins a full magazine in. Chambers drain after 4s without a hit.

dash.name: Slide Reload
dash.desc: Tap: a 3.4m roll that slips 35% of the magazine in (roll through a hit as it lands: your next shots crit). Hold: a 6m low slide you can shoot from that fully reloads at the end; let go early to refund 30%.

variants.tap: A ricochet round 9m: 12 damage, bounces off up to 2 walls and on to a second foe (+20% a bounce).
variants.hold: Rail Charge: hold up to 1s, a piercing rail 10 to 34 damage, 9 to 17m; full charge stuns 0.6.
variants.air: Recoil Shot: fire down and forward, kicked 3m up and back, the target pushed 6.
variants.during_e: During Quickdraw it fires two rounds, the second 0.1s later at 60%.
variants.full: At 6 Chambers: a Called Shot (+70%, crit, stun 0.4; a full reload when it lands).

e.name: Quickdraw
e.desc: For 3s: fire 25% faster, an instant reload, a dash charge back, and your next Slide Reload's perfect-dodge window is twice as long.

r.name: Last Round
r.desc: Channel up to 1.2s (slowed): gold lock lines draw to every rival hunter within 12m in sight. Press R again (or wait) to fire one round per lock: 16 + 12 per second locked; a full lock stuns 0.5. Breaking line of sight drops the lock.

rank3.dash: a perfect dodge also loads 2 chambers

rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 9s -> 6.3s; a perfect dodge also loads 2 chambers.

tells.half: the gold cylinder over the hat fills pip by pip
tells.full: a gold glow at the gun, the cylinder spinning, a click
